meta.note: T7 constants for the P2 driver. All values are certified upper bounds (lower bounds for c_I, c_tau_c, mu1, mu2, nV_min) unless status says pending. theta_I = 0.025 (closure theta_0). Directions g = (p~, n~, V_s), V_s = -k'' + c p + b n; T6 residual corrections (V~ = V_s + r in g3, b1 += int k r) not included (sensitivity in T7_REPORT).
meta.weight: W = (1+x^2)^-2 on [10.25, ell~] with T8 far-end flattening X = ell Phi(x/ell) (s0 = 1/2)
meta.constraints: phi_1 = chi_32 p_L, phi_2 = chi_32 n_L (t7/phi_store.json, base7.late_base), phi_3 = chi_32 psi3^ (c4fun.PSI)

closure.reserve: Ds = theta0/4 B^2 + eps/8 D4^2 + mu_e/8 V2^2 + mu_e eps_I/8 V4^2 (unchanged): Q(z) - Ds - NL(z) >= rho_c Lambda_e

not_certified.0: outside P2 (SLAB0 = 2): T8 n3.json has no far majorants for these slabs

closure.note: closure_cert.py --nl nl_terms.json: Q - Ds - NL >= rho_c Lambda_e on all shapes (AM-GM relaxation + arb LDL); NL = nonlinear terms N, Q and the nonlinear/E_ij part of (M), reduced to quadratic terms on the box (T7_REPORT 4c)

closure_linear.note: closure_cert.py: Q >= rho_c Lambda_e on all shapes (AM-GM relaxation + arb LDL), T5 2.4 form, (E2) AB form

nonlinear_closure.validity: Lambda_e <= Ybox^2 on the interval, T8 box B' (n3.json run at Y = 1.7e-12), Lemma 4b tip box (eta1 = c_e1 Ybox <= 1e-5)
nonlinear_closure.n_dependence: tip: nl7 n4, n3_0, n2_0, n21, m2, m23 (T5 box, valid for eta1 <= 1e-5) times eta1, S_W (both linear in Ybox); A31 = 10 e'/J^6 and At analytic; ramp/middle: D(N) monomial coefficients (TD2 enclosures, nlsym/nlforms_gen.py) with T6 jets; far core x >= 30.25: T8 n3.json per-range majorants (Atp, A, A1, B0, B1, dCe, beta, G) per slab

tip_box.statement: |e(x)| <= c_e(x) Lambda_e^1/2, |e'(x)| <= c_e1(x) Lambda_e^1/2 on [0, 34.249]; sup: c_e, c_e1 (Lemma 4b)

modulation_nl.statement: (M): |x^ - x^_lin - x^_res| <= mbar |b_NL| + mbar|E|/(1 - mbar|E|) (C_x A + x_r + mbar |b_NL|) (T7_REPORT 4c(M))

K_e.definition: |e(x)| <= K_e Ybar for x <= x_a = 14 + X0 (T8 level-0 ramp start): w = e^{-phi/2} u, w(34.25) = 0, w^2 <= 2|w||w'|, |w'| <= W1 + sup|phi'|/2 A, W1^2 <= AB + c1 A^2 <= Lambda (1/(2 sqrt eps) + c1)

T6_sensitivity.formula: 2 mbar Cx_full ||chi r||_rho / nV_min + (sup|k r| + sup|phi' int k r|)/2 on [0, 34.25]

widths_args.note: only se_corr.bump_norms (exact bump sups/L1 norms) is used from se_corr.py when source = t6c

far7_check.note: far7 widens only k^(0..3) and Q; out_far (se_corr widths) contains the direct widths, so it holds for the corrected base

se_correction.direct: review B1: p2/t6c (T6 engine on the corrected base); nl7 rerun and farg increments recomputed with the direct widths
se_correction.note: far constants (far7 mu1/mu2/a_mu/Hardy, nl7 far boxes, farg Gamma0/Gamma2) hold for the (SE)-corrected base (STEP4_RESULT 2(ii)): jets widened on x >= 0.6 ell_lo, farg by certified increments; all tip-region constants (certificates, C3, E2, strip, ramp, Gamma2E, tip n_j) are unchanged since the corrected base equals the polished one there
